title: a note answer never takes a patient off the list (ring 0, D-1072)

findings.claim: two models agreeing on a stated note exclusion took the patient off the investigator's list on every path; fixed: review with both quotes and the reason code notes_suggest_not_eligible
NAV dropped a patient for a note "not met" on an inclusion; fixed: the patient stays on the sheet with the inclusion a row to confirm, and a draft never writes a note exclusion as present

with TB_NOTE_BLOCK=both_agree on v1 a pair's note not-met is stored final: true (cascade: false), so a patient the coded records exclude also lists that note criterion as a reason on the criteria-not-matched page, as an inclusion's did before; not under the default never
the schema texts of evidence.opinions, affirmed and final still say opinions mean a disagreement and that such an answer may exclude; the texts are the contract lane's
deploy comments, code docstrings and check labels of the end-to-end tools still say a note excludes when both models agree
findings.place: deploy/docker-compose.*.yml, deploy/install.sh, deploy/dgpu48-profile.yaml, tools/e2e_simple.py, tools/public_e2e.py, tools/scenarios.py

findings.claim: feasibility counts drop a patient on an absence in the notes with no model answer (certified zero hits, index condition absent); a separate card after ring 0
for lane H's card: the installer writes TB_NOTE_BLOCK=both_agree and the doctor reads an unset one as both_agree (its tests pin it); neither can exclude a patient, both decide final only

NAV still keeps a patient off the likely-eligible sheet for a note inclusion answered unknown (disagreement, no quote, weak or cut "met"), and for a coded unknown, as before; only the note "not met" was ruled
